items.title: Paul Barnes Interview, 1969-06-16
items.q: Yeah, I played with everybody around here.

ctx.x: Cali Piggott? Yeah. He plays more like the, like you were saying?

Yeah, more like the original than any other. But he don't play long, because the fellas won't let him play it, they make him play the Dixaland style. So he's practically dying out now. Is Dave Bailey playing anymore?
